name: Foreshore
summary: Private wealth management in calm daylight: a white page, one deep navy band for the office, and copper only as a hairline or a link. A short headline in light Mona Sans with air around it, the plain line of what the firm does under it, then one wide photograph of people seen from a distance (a family walking a misty shore) and a quiet sentence to complete: I am selling a business and I live in the UK. How we help in four calm columns, insights with photographs and the not-advice line, the office with its time now. Every photograph in one warm daylight grade. For wealth managers and family offices with one or a few offices.
